title: Contact Support: Credits, Billing and Results | AIVideosUGC
description: Questions about credits, a failed job, billing or your account? Email support@aivideosugc.com for a written answer and help with your next ad.
lead: Stuck on a photo, a video, your credits or your account? Email us and we'll help you get back to making ads.
intro: Email support@aivideosugc.com and include the details below so the team can help in one reply. Email also leaves you a written record of the question and the fix.

To sort it in one reply, include the email address on your account, a short description of the problem and, if it is about a specific photo or video, roughly when you made it. A screenshot of any error message helps too.

topics.d: Questions about your plan, a charge on your statement, or which plan fits the amount of content you make.
If a job failed and the credits did not come back, or a cost was not what you expected, tell us what happened and we will check the job.
If a photo or video came out very different from your description, send us the details and we will take a look.
Trouble signing in, or questions about who can see your uploads and results.
If you run a store, an agency or a creator channel and want to work with us, email a short note about your audience or business and what you have in mind.

faq.q: How do I get help with AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. Email is the quickest way to reach us, and it gives you a written record of your question and our answer.

faq.q: Can you help me before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. If you are not sure the tools suit your products, email a short note about what you sell and where you advertise, and we will point you to the right place to start.

faq.q: How long does support take to reply?
faq.a: We will reply as soon as we can. Send the account and job details in your first email so the answer does not need a second round.

faq.q: What details help support find my job?
faq.a: Include the email on your account, a brief description of the issue, roughly when it happened, and a screenshot of any error message.

faq.q: What happens to my credits if a job fails?
faq.a: Failed jobs return their credits to your balance automatically. If you do not see them back, email support with the time of the job and we will check it for you.
Email support@aivideosugc.com. Include the email on your account and a short description of what you need.
